findings.evidence: Meson/Pdf/Basic.lean:20-21 states the convention ("the momentum sum rule and the sum rule for each species are likewise the species-level bundle `PDF.SumRuleAssumptions`, instantiated rather than restated"); roadmap README.md:421 "The sum rules are instantiated, not restated"; README.md:484 asks for densities that "satisfy all of 1.2".
findings.fix: Add `sumRuleAssumptionsCountingRuleModelPdf [Fintype Flavor] : PDF.SumRuleAssumptions M.countingRuleModelPdf` (momentum from `sum_mellinMoment_one_countingRuleModelPdf`, `valenceTarget s := M.valenceModelWeight s / 2`, valence from `mellinMoment_countingRuleModelPdf_of_le_one zero_le_one`) with its `_valenceTarget` simp lemma, and state both independence theorems with `PDF.SumRuleAssumptions f` in place of the inline momentum condition.
findings.issue: `not_forall_countingRuleHypothesis_of_sumRules` and `not_forall_not_countingRuleHypothesis_of_sumRules` (lines 202-203, 213-214) restate the momentum sum rule inline as `∀ Q2, ∑ s, PDF.mellinMoment f 1 s Q2 = 1` instead of taking `PDF.SumRuleAssumptions f`, and `countingRuleModelPdf` exposes no `PDF.SumRuleAssumptions` bundle although `valenceModelPdf` does (`Meson/Pdf/Basic.lean:383 sumRuleAssumptionsValenceModelPdf`, :387 its `_valenceTarget` simp lemma). Both witnesses satisfy the bundle, so the weaker hypothesis only weakens both exposed statements.

findings.evidence: Basic.lean:306 `rw [Pi.add_apply, Pi.add_apply, Pi.add_apply, ...]`; Basic.lean:247 `@[simp] lemma weight_apply`.
findings.fix: Add `@[simp] lemma add_apply (f g : Pdf ι) (i : ι) (x Q2 : ℝ) : (f + g) i x Q2 = f i x Q2 + g i x Q2 := (rfl)` in the `Add` section, and use it in `IsPartonDensity.add` and `mellinMoment_add`.
findings.issue: The new `Add` section introduces `+` on `Pdf ι` as a public operation but supplies no `add_apply` lemma, unlike the two sibling operations (`comap_apply` at :169-172 and `weight_apply` at :247-250, both `@[simp]`). Every consumer must peel `Pi.add_apply` three times, as the PR's own proofs do at :306 and :327.

findings.evidence: Meson/Pdf/LargeX.lean:148-156 (`{n : ℕ} (hn : n ≤ 1)`, proof ends `interval_cases n`); Parton/PDF/Model.lean:195 `mellinMoment_modelPdf` gives the closed form for every `n`.
findings.fix: State the general closed form `mellinMoment_countingRuleModelPdf (n : ℕ) (s) (Q2)` via `mellinMoment_add` + `mellinMoment_weight` + `mellinMoment_modelPdf`, and derive `mellinMoment_countingRuleModelPdf_of_le_one` from it.
findings.issue: `countingRuleModelPdf`'s only moment lemma is restricted to `n ≤ 1`, while its sibling has `@[simp] mellinMoment_valenceModelPdf` for every `n` (Meson/Pdf/Basic.lean:354). Since this module is `public section` without `@[expose]` (line 66), the definition's body is unavailable downstream, so no consumer can obtain the `n ≥ 2` moments — the very moments that distinguish the two models — without redoing the integral from `countingRuleModelPdf_apply`.

summary: The headline independence theorems restate the momentum sum rule inline instead of instantiating the repo's `PDF.SumRuleAssumptions` bundle, and `countingRuleModelPdf` does not expose that bundle although its sibling `valenceModelPdf` does; the new `+` operation on `Pdf` and the new model are also missing the apply/moment lemmas their siblings carry.
